Hardware-aware mixed precision can choose different formats for model weights and cached keys and values, but the benefit depends on whether the runtime actually uses efficient kernels and whether quality remains stable. In a long-context workload, KV-cache memory grows with sequence length, number of layers, hidden size, number of KV heads, and dtype width. A lower-precision KV cache should matter most when contexts are long enough that cache allocation and bandwidth become visible in measured latency and memory. In a long-context workload, KV-cache memory grows with sequence length, number of layers, hidden size, number of KV heads, and dtype width. A lower-precision KV cache should matter most when contexts are long enough that cache allocation and bandwidth become visible in measured latency and memory.
